text:
jess_support: Hey team, escalation from a paying customer. They're getting truncated streaming responses from /v1/streams/generate — final JSON object never arrives, finish_reason is absent and client hangs waiting for the final token. They see 200 then a connection close. Ticket #CS-8642.

alex_customer: Repro steps I gave them: curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \u0027https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/generate?model=rwd-3b\u0027 -d '{"prompt":"long text...","stream":true}'
They see a bunch of SSE events like `data: {"token":"..."}` then the connection just closes mid-response. No `data: [DONE]`.

jess_support: Customer says this started ~2 weeks ago, previously stable. They tested from two regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1) and both show same behavior. They also tried with our JS SDK (v1.4.2) and raw curl.

mike_runtime: Can you paste the raw last bytes from the client side? Also X-Request-ID if you have it. My first guess is intermediate proxy tearing connection or our runtime hit an internal timeout and didn't emit final chunk.

alex_customer: Here's the last bit from curl -v (redacted):
```
> GET /v1/streams/generate?model=rwd-3b HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.ai
> Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: text/event-stream
< transfer-encoding: chunked
< x-request-id: 3f9c7a2b
...
data: {"token":"..."}\n
[connection closed by peer]
```
They also attached server side log snippet: `req_id=3f9c7a2b status=200 duration=29532ms bytes_sent=18234` then nothing.

mike_runtime: Ok thanks. duration ~29.5s — interesting. We have a 30s header/body timeout in the ingress policy? tara_sre, any LB/edge timeouts around 30s?

tara_sre: Pulling logs now. I see an upstream RST from envoy to backend for some of these traces at ~30s. Packet dump shows FIN from our side immediately after last SSE chunk. Looks like the runtime finished sending but the finalization (closing JSON, sending final finish_reason chunk) is missing in the stream payload. Curious: do we do a buffered flush on final frame?

mike_runtime: We flush intermediate tokens, but finalization logic writes a small terminal chunk with finish_reason, then triggers `Response.complete()`. If ENVOY sends RST earlier or a proxy drops the connection as soon as body transfer ceases, the tiny final chunk might be lost. That would leave client with partial JSON and no `data: [DONE]`.

jess_support: Customer asks whether this is billable — their client saw many tokens, then post-processing hung and retried, leading to duplicate charges. Need guidance to advise them.

mike_runtime: Short answer: tokenization and generation already occurred; the generation tokens counted. We should warn about client retries. We'll add guidance in CS response.

repro-bot: Automated repro: ran curl with body size=8k, stream=true, loop 50x. Failure rate ~6%. Attached TTL traces and tcpdump.

mike_runtime: Reproduced locally using a small repro. Curl command I used:
```
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/generate \
  -d '{"prompt":"repeat x 1000","stream":true}'
```
Observed same abrupt close, last bytes were a partial JSON (missing closing brace and finish_reason).

mike_runtime: Hypothesis: when generation completes very close to envoy's timeout window, the final tiny chunk flush competes with connection teardown. If envoy triggers idle/stream window closure we may lose terminal bytes. Two paths: adjust LB timeouts/keepalives, or make runtime send a heartbeat/keepalive every ~10s so final closure isn't the only activity.

tara_sre: I temporarily bumped envoy idle_timeout to 60s for the affected pool. Re-ran repro 100x, failure rate dropped to 0%. That suggests timeouts. We'll propose a standard config change for stable streams and consider backport.

jess_support: Can we provide customer a mitigation they can do immediately?

mike_runtime: Yes: 1) Use SDK v1.5.0 (we'll publish) which includes a small keepalive ping for streaming connections; 2) Short-term, client can implement reconnect with resume token support: include last received token index so server can continue. We're working on resume APIs but not GA.

alex_customer: Will an SDK update require their app restart?

mike_runtime: No breaking changes. We'll publish a patch to add keepalive and improved final flush ordering. ETA 48h for canary.

jess_support: Tara, can you confirm whether this change affects Dedicated/Private customers differently?

tara_sre: Dedicated customers use different LB config; they didn't show this behavior in our samples. Private deployments depend on customer infra. We'll add a KB note explaining required LB timeouts and keepalive behavior.

mike_runtime: Action items:
- mike_runtime: push v1.5.0 SDK patch with streaming keepalive and robust final flush (PR #4287).
- tara_sre: roll envoy idle_timeout bump to prod pool and prepare rollback plan (SRE runbook).
- jess_support: reply to customer with mitigation steps, explanation on billing, and expected SDK timeline.
- eng-runtime: investigate resume token API feasibility (spike).

repro-bot: Added traces to CS ticket CS-8642 and flagged for priority support.

alex_customer: Thanks, please keep me posted — their L7 app is relying on streaming to show incremental progress.

jess_support: Will update when canary's out. Marking this thread resolved for now but keep incident watch for any regressions. :thumbsup:
